diagnostic_method: Equal criterion weights; retain published City z scores; equity standardized across all 24 with population SD separately in each scenario; competition ranks; available-case proportional reweighting for missing City cells
limitations: No common-baseline counterfactual data to harmonize conditional City forecasts
Road buffers differ from station catchments; seven general shortest paths differ from seventeen named-road proxies
Observed-minimum substitution is not a theoretical worst-case bound or proof of robust ordering
Historical income/population and City observation/forecast vintages differ
